284989401.description:
Natural Quartz Geode Specimen Pair
Crystalline Rock Cavity Halves
Raw Mineral Formation, 2 Pieces
This pair of natural geode halves features interior cavities lined with sparkling crystalline quartz and calcite formations resting within a rugged natural rock matrix. Formed millions of years ago in volcanic or sedimentary bubbles, geodes showcase distinctive internal crystal growth patterns, making them enduring favorites among mineral collectors, geology enthusiasts, and natural decor curators.
Includes two matching natural geode halves with exposed crystalline cavities
Densely packed translucent to milky quartz crystal points and druzy clusters
Rough, unaltered exterior host rock with authentic geological texture and coloration
Measures approximately 9 x 5 x 3.5 inches combined and weighs 2.4 lbs
Condition:
Natural geological specimens in raw, unpolished condition. Crystal formations are intact with crisp termination points and natural surface variations. Exterior host rock displays natural earthy textures, fissures, and authentic mineral matrix characteristics consistent with wild-harvested rock specimens.
